newsitem.title: USA: American Brands sets trading alternatives.
newsitem.headline: American Brands sets trading alternatives.

text.p: American Brands Inc said on Thursday that its investors would have the right to receive one American Depositary Share of Gallaher Group Plc for each share of American Brands common stock held during trading this week.
Each ADS represents four ordinary shares of Gallaher, American Brands said in a statement.

The ADSs, which apply to stock traded on the New York Stock Exchange, will be issued in connection with the spin-off of Gallaher, a wholly owned subsidiary of American Brands. The company previously set May 30 as the record and payment date for the spinoff.

The company specified that trades made in its common stock from May 27 to May 30 would carry due-bills, representing the right to receive the ADSs. These due-bills will be redeemed on June 4, it said.
In addition to trading American Brands through due-bills, investors will also be able to make trades in American Brands common stock "Ex-Distribution" - "When Issued" on May 30, the company said.
American Brands also noted that its name will change to Fortune Brands Inc and that common stock of Fortune Brands will begin trading on June 2 under the symbol FO.N.
